rules.scope: Additional explicitly named observed endpoint/path correspondence; do not replace original exact-set checker or retroactively mark it passed.
rules.endpointEquality: Require exact initial and settled endpoint tuples equal to both recorded controls; same board root/camera/layout viewport endpoint values, same actual matching ARView identity within each run.
rules.path: Every observed matching board ARView frame must lie on A+lambda*(B-A), lambda within[0,1], observed lambda nondecreasing. Use at most1e-5 point component residual solely for floating serialization arithmetic, far below a layout unit. Do not use bounding-box or pixel tolerance to hide geometry changes.
rules.semanticWindow: All non-endpoint samples must occur only during the first active-selection startup transition and strictly before the first screenshot command starts. Require B at the first complete board census after that screenshot ends, with that observation no later than the second(+1s) screenshot command end. All later observed board frames through the final tail must remain exactly B. If any of these conditions fails, stop/review; no compensating frames or further heuristic extension.
rules.unchangedGates: Preserve all existing CPU brackets, complete trace/tail, actual camera/clip facts, lifecycle order/counts, source/binary/package parity, all whole-image judgments and phase timing gates. No source/validator/runtime edits by this audit.
rules.why: Set equality compares time-sampled animation positions from different offsets; endpoint/path/window correspondence tests geometric layout equivalence at the resolution actually observed. It deliberately does not claim temporal equivalence.

interpretation: Projection configuration comparison includes initialization/workload timing. No claim of identical animation timing or first capture settled. Original exact-set failure remains failed.
runtime: Same eef5a676 binary/source, no build/install/protocol changes; P2 once, O2 only if P2 passes.
